findings.finding: Unexpected strictSimulate throws an ordinary Error without latching globalAbort. The request counter append is unreachable. Unlike the prefix guard, this does not ensure experiment-wide fatal termination; invocation catches ordinary failures and the outer loop continues when globalAbort is unset. Actual Rust dispatch is prevented, but the specified fatal guard contract is not met.

varianceFinding.interpretation: B's only pair wins and favorable p95 coincide with late A stalls in an identical already-singleton read, not a multi-item response barrier. With six samples p95 is the maximum. Source/backend caches are fresh per invocation but provider/connection conditions are not reset; the first B opened two additional sockets and later runs reused sockets. Do not discard cold or slow samples, infer a stable tail win, or attribute all timing differences to batch size. The observed header/body waits do not isolate provider execution from network or client scheduling.
